name: DEMO-Init-Test: Missing Liveness Probe (main only)
description: Demo policy for the RHACS init-container test workflow. Fires when a regular (non-init) container in acs-init-container-test has no liveness probe. Init containers are excluded via evaluationFilter.skipContainerTypes = INIT (Skip init containers in the UI) because Kubernetes forbids livenessProbe on init containers - without that exclusion every init would be a false positive. Only red-app should match: clean/dirty/blue define a probe on main; red deliberately does not. Inform only (no enforcement).
rationale: Long-running application containers should expose a liveness probe so the kubelet can restart unhealthy processes. Init containers run to completion and must not define one.
remediation: Add a livenessProbe to the main/application container. Do not add one to init containers - Kubernetes rejects that. Keep this policy on Skip init containers so only regular containers are evaluated.
